verified_paths: Qualified names and inherited type, flags, values, defaults, options and constraints
Widget page and Rect mapping across two pages
Batch text, checkbox, radio, list and combo edits followed by fresh parser reopening
Every changed widget has a nonempty selected normal appearance stream
Independent Unicode appearance reopening without the borrowed host font
Clearing text produces no ink in the isolated interior text probe
Original byte prefix is preserved and caller input remains unchanged
ReadOnly, Required, MaxLen, options, duplicate changes, missing fields and invalid UTF-8 reject atomically
Field-tree malformed types, cycles, duplicate qualified names, inconsistent Parent and resource limits reject atomically
Unsupported modes, actions, XFA, direct fields, rotation, permissions, missing glyphs and empty visible outlines reject atomically
Hidden shaping glyphs are skipped; bidirectional appearance layout is explicitly unsupported
Cancellation at entry, during shaping and after final export progress clears output and preserves input
75 independent documents enumerate, edit, save and reopen with values, option indexes, AS and AP verified per widget
Unedited widgets keep their appearance stream hash and unedited fields keep their values
A refused or cancelled write leaves source bytes unchanged, clears outputs, repeats identically and still allows a zero-change copy
Separate readers agree: qpdf structure, pypdf field tree, options, /I, button states and appearance text, poppler raster ink
The same acceptance rules reproduce through the installed EXReader::exr_pdf_edit component on Linux and Windows

corpus_gate_iterations_retained.observed_failure: Corpus summary tee ran before the build directory existed; the checker joined widgets with the same comma that separates widget rects.
pypdf get_fields reported ancestor fields and skipped inherited values.
Reference input validation repeated the get_fields limits.
An appearance stream was read as a state dictionary, so its keys became button states.
Six documents used a dotted partial field name, which is malformed PDF and was correctly refused; the checker also indexed a missing field table.
The checker indexed a write record for the eight unreadable documents.
Ink measurement ran the fixed renderer without a fallback face, and the refusal path reported the caller input as modified.
Cancelled documents recorded no repeat or cleanup record.
Only the three cancellation records remained; everything else passed.
The installed consumer fused the field name and value hex and covered no document.
The installed consumer kept a pointer into the line buffer and lost the document name.
All build and acceptance jobs passed; the sanitizer job produced no evidence manifest for reconciliation.

prior_runs_retained.observed_failure: Shaping size exceeded the public API limit.
Overlapping radio appearance hid the text rendering probe.
Bitmap-only test used a string containing a glyph absent from its font.
X9-removed hidden scalar level was treated as requiring bidi layout.

remaining_limits: Single-line values and one LTR shaping run; no complete multi-script/bidi appearance layout or font fallback.
White background, black border/text and fitted size replace original DA/MK/BS appearance styling.
List appearance shows selected labels without full scrolling or interactive controls.
Multiline, password, comb, rich text, file-select, editable/multiselect combo and rotated widgets are rejected.
Signature, pushbutton, unknown/direct field/widget, actions, XFA, Catalog permission constraints and encrypted writeback are not implemented.
Incremental output retains historical values and does not perform redaction.
The independent corpus is generated from source in CI; the PDF bytes are published as run artifacts, not committed to the repository.
